## Alecto (Lesser Fury) (CR 4)

Disheveled hair, mottled white-and-brown wings with rotted feathers, and wild eyes, this woman could be a fallen angel or a risen fiend. Her whip cracks while she eagerly looks around for prey.  

**XP** 1,200  
LN Medium outsider (devil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness, true seeing; Perception +11  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)  
**hp** 60 (5d10+10)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +7, **Will** +4  
**DR** 5/good; **Immune** fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (good)  
**Melee** whip +9 (1d3+3 plus entangle) or 2 claws +8 (1d4+3)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 8th; concentration +11)  


Constant—true seeing  

At will—cause fear (DC 15), greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)  

1/day—terrible remorse (DC 18), summon (level 3, 1 alecto or 1d4 lemures, 50%)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 19, **Con** 15, **Int** 14, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Weapon Focus (whip), Whip Mastery  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +12, Fly +18, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (planes, religion) +10, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +12  
**Languages** Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** implacable  


**Special Abilities**



**Entangle (Su)** On a successful hit, an alecto can order her whip to entangle opponents of any size as an animate rope spell (CL 12th, DC 16). This ability only works for a whip that the alecto is wielding. The save DC is Dexterity-based.  

**Implacable (Su)** As a standard action, an alecto can designate a creature as her quarry, thus becoming able of locating it as if the creature was marked with a brand of tracking. An alecto receives a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls made against her quarry, and all critical threats are automatically confirmed; in addition, the quarry suffers a -2 penalty on saving throws against the alecto’s supernatural and spell-like abilities. An alecto can have no more than one quarry at a time but can change her designated quarry whenever she wills as a standard action.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any (Hell)  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
